[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.10.2 - repairs[/b][/size]

The Inquisition jailor's Rites of Confession -- an Inquisitor's training arc with prisoners to
question and a three-tier Speech lesson worth up to 250 XP -- was built end to end and could
never be completed: the reply that opens the lesson needed a flag nothing set. It can now.
Also the Templar inspection route is once-only as written, and 0.10.0's needle trap plays its
line.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. The jailor works on any save; the trap needs a
character who hasn't entered Montserrat's first hall.
